reference: If he turns the ring once more, she will drop the price again.
sk: Ak prsteň otočí ešte raz, zníži cenu znova.
cz: Když prsten otočí ještě jednou, sníží cenu znovu.
acceptable: If {he|she} turns the ring {once more|one more time}, {she|he} will {drop|lower|reduce|cut} the price again.
{She|He} will {drop|lower|reduce|cut} the price again if {he|she} turns the ring {once more|one more time}.

mistakes.text: If {he|she} will turn the ring once more, {she|he} will drop the price again.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „if“ patrí v First Conditional Present Simple: „if he turns“, nie „will turn“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „if“ patří ve First Conditional Present Simple: „if he turns“, ne „will turn“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In First Conditional use Present Simple after “if”: “if he turns”, not “will turn”.

mistakes.text: If {he|she} turns the ring once more, {she|he} drops the price again.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Následok v budúcnosti vyjadruje v First Conditional „will“: „will drop“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Následek v budoucnosti vyjadřuje ve First Conditional „will“: „will drop“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The future result in First Conditional needs “will”: “will drop”.

mistakes.text: If {he|she} turned the ring once more, {she|he} would drop the price again.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Ide o reálnu možnosť, preto First Conditional „turns … will drop“, nie „turned … would drop“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Jde o reálnou možnost, proto First Conditional „turns … will drop“, ne „turned … would drop“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This is a real possibility, so use First Conditional “turns … will drop”, not “would”.

mistakes.text: If {he|she} turn the ring once more, {she|he} will drop the price again.
If {he|she} turns the ring once more, {she|he} is going to drop the price again.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Cvičenie precvičuje First Conditional s „will“: „will drop“ namiesto „is going to drop“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Cvičení procvičuje First Conditional s „will“: „will drop“ místo „is going to drop“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This exercise practises First Conditional with “will”: use “will drop”, not “is going to”.

mistakes.text: If {he|she} turns once more the ring, {she|he} will drop the price again.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Once more“ nestojí medzi slovesom a predmetom: „turns the ring once more“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Once more“ nestojí mezi slovesem a předmětem: „turns the ring once more“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Don't put “once more” between the verb and its object: “turns the ring once more”.

source_issues: Slovak and Czech drop the subject pronouns, so “he” and “she” are not given; all he/she combinations are accepted.
